notes.title: Gameplay Enhancements & First Anti-Cheat Test Update 🚀
notes.content:
Attention, Space Memory Pilots! 🚀

We’re excited to announce a small but important update that enhances your gameplay experience and introduces our first round of Anti-Cheat testing.

🎮 Gameplay Adjustments

Improved Nest & UFO Interaction: We’ve fine-tuned the balance between nest destruction and UFO collection. Time penalties and point deductions now scale more smoothly with your game progress.
Turret Mode Optimization: Turret Mode has been adjusted to offer a more strategic experience. Activating Turret Mode around UFO clusters now offers a slightly longer window for destruction, allowing for better chaining of multipliers.
Score Scaling: We’ve tweaked the point system to reward efficient gameplay even more. The multiplier now decays slower, giving you more time to maintain high scores while hunting UFOs.
🛡️ Anti-Cheat Test – Phase 1

Cheat Detection System Activated: We’ve integrated the first version of our Anti-Cheat system, designed to monitor gameplay patterns like unusual score spikes, unexpected time increases, and manipulated nest interactions.
Real-Time Warnings: If the system detects potential cheating, you’ll receive dynamic in-game warnings, starting with small hints and escalating if suspicious behavior continues.
Your Feedback Matters: This is a beta test of the Anti-Cheat system, so please report any false positives or issues you encounter. Your input helps us improve the system for future updates!
🔧 Ongoing Optimizations

We’re continuing to smooth out performance and refine the leaderboard system for even better player competition.
Known issues like minor UI glitches and incorrect notification timings are being addressed in the upcoming patches.
Thank you for your continued support as we take Space Memory TDG to the next level. Stay sharp, keep your gameplay fair, and as always, aim for the stars! 🌠

notes.title: 🚀 Space Memory Gameplay Update 🚀
notes.content:
🚩 Gameplay Mechanics & Strategies
Card Gameplay

Find Pairs: Click to match pairs, gaining points for correct matches. Mistakes will incur time penalties that scale with your score.
Pair Bonus: Matched pairs grant points and time bonuses, increased by your active multiplier.
UFO Mechanics

UFO Movement: UFOs roam the scene, collecting nests and dodging collisions.
Nest Collection Penalty: Each nest collected by UFOs adds a time penalty, growing with remaining game time.
UFO Destruction: Destroy UFOs for points and short time advantages. Chain kills to boost your kill-streak multiplier for additional points.
Turret Mode

Activation: Trigger manually or by matching two consecutive pairs. Manual activation costs extra time.
Destroy Targets: Use Turret Mode to strategically destroy UFOs and nests, but beware—destroying nests reduces your score, especially at higher levels.
Limited Time: Turret Mode is time-bound, and the countdown is displayed in your HUD.
Nests & Penalties

UFO Nest Destruction: UFOs destroying nests cause time penalties, which escalate based on remaining nests and game time.
Player Nest Destruction: Destroy nests yourself to avoid UFO-induced penalties, but it costs points—higher scores mean bigger deductions.
Nest Multiplier: Destroying nests raises your multiplier, affecting future penalties.

🎯 Points, Multipliers, and Key Strategies
Multiplier System

Earn Points for Pairs & UFOs: Points are awarded for matching pairs and destroying UFOs. A higher multiplier means more points!
Keep the Multiplier High: Increase the multiplier with quick pairs and UFO kills. Be quick—letting too much time pass will reset it.
Strategic Play

Quick Pairs: Match cards swiftly to build up your multiplier and avoid penalties.
Optimize Turret Mode: Activate it around UFO groups to maximize destruction and points.
Watch the Nests: Target UFOs near nests to minimize penalties, and use destroyed nests to increase multipliers.

🏆 Steamworks & Leaderboards
Leaderboards are LIVE! Compete against fellow players on Steam! Each level has its leaderboard—test your skills and climb to the top.
Ongoing Optimizations: Experience smoother transitions, improved performance, and fully functional leaderboard tracking.
Known Issues: We're addressing minor bugs like missing icons and leaderboard glitches. Updates are on the way!


🚀 Upcoming Features
Options Menu Return: The Options menu will be back soon, with enhanced customization for your game settings.
Framerate & VSync Fixes: Expect smoother framerates and better VSync controls for a seamless experience.
Thank you, Space Memory Pilots!
Continue testing, improving, and aiming for the stars. Your journey has only just begun. 🌠

This final version combines everything into one cohesive update, with headings and structure that cover gameplay, strategies, and Steamworks integration. Let me know if this suits your vision!

notes.title: Game Update: Enhanced Mechanics and Strategic Play Improvements
notes.content:
Game Mechanics

Card Gameplay

Finding Pairs: Click on cards to match pairs. If they match, they remain face-up, and you earn points. Incorrect attempts impose a time penalty, which increases with your score.
Bonus for Pairs: Each matched pair grants points and an additional time bonus, which is amplified by your multiplier.

UFO Mechanics

Movement and Collision: UFOs move through the scene, collecting nests and avoiding collisions.
Time Penalty for Nest Collection: Each collected nest imposes a time penalty, which is higher when the overall time is high.
Destroying UFOs: Destroyed UFOs grant points and a short time advantage. Consecutive destructions increase the kill-streak multiplier, giving additional points.

Turret Mode

Activation: The mode can be activated manually or by finding two consecutive pairs. Manual activation costs extra time.
Target Options: Use the mode strategically to destroy UFOs and nests. Destroyed nests cause point deductions, which increase with the number of destroyed nests and your score.
Countdown: The turret mode time is limited and is displayed in the HUD.

Nests and Time Penalties

Nest Destruction by UFOs: If a UFO destroys a nest, you incur a time penalty that increases with the remaining nests and playtime.
Nest Destruction by Player: You can destroy a nest to avoid a UFO-imposed time penalty. However, this deducts points – the higher your score, the greater the deduction.
Multiplier for Destroyed Nests: Each destroyed nest increases the multiplier, which also impacts your time penalties.

Points and Multipliers

Points for Pairs and UFOs: Each matched card pair and destroyed UFO grants points, influenced by the multiplier.
Multiplier System: The game multiplier increases with successful pairs and UFO destructions. The kill-streak multiplier for UFOs rises with quick destruction and resets if too much time passes.

UI Elements and Notifications

Displays: The HUD shows remaining time, score, turret mode time, and multiplier.
Notifications: Important events like time penalties and high scores are displayed as brief messages.

Strategies

Pairs and Multiplier: Find pairs quickly to use the multiplier and avoid penalties.
Effective Turret Mode: Activate the mode near UFO groups to maximize multiplier and points.
Keep an Eye on Nests: Destroy UFOs near nests to avoid time penalties.
Tactical Multiplier Use: Apply the multiplier strategically, especially with high score opportunities.

Advanced Tips

Precision Gameplay: High scores lead to stricter penalties. Minimizing mistakes is crucial with a high score.
Special Abilities: Use power-ups to gain significant time bonuses or extend turret mode.



---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Spielmechaniken

Karten-Gameplay

Paare Finden: Klicke auf Karten, um Paare zu bilden. Stimmen sie überein, bleiben sie aufgedeckt, und du erhältst Punkte. Bei Fehlversuchen wird eine Zeitstrafe verhängt, die mit deinem Score steigt.
Bonus für Paare: Jedes gefundene Paar gewährt dir Punkte und einen zusätzlichen Zeitbonus, der durch deinen Multiplikator verstärkt wird.

UFO-Mechaniken

Bewegung und Kollision: UFOs bewegen sich durch die Szene, sammeln Nester ein und weichen bei Kollisionen aus.
Zeitstrafe bei Nest-Einsammlung: Jedes eingesammelte Nest bringt eine Zeitstrafe, die bei hohem Zeitstand höher ausfällt.
Zerstörung von UFOs: Zerstörte UFOs bringen Punkte und eine kurze Zeitvergünstigung. Mit aufeinanderfolgenden Zerstörungen steigt der Kill-Streak-Multiplikator, was dir zusätzliche Punkte einbringt.

Turret-Modus

Aktivierung: Der Modus kann manuell aktiviert oder durch das Finden von zwei Paaren in Folge ausgelöst werden. Das manuelle Aktivieren kostet zusätzliche Zeit.
Zieloptionen: Nutze den Modus strategisch, um UFOs und Nester zu zerstören. Zerstörte Nester verursachen jedoch Punkteabzüge, die mit der Anzahl zerstörter Nester und deinem Punktestand steigen.
Countdown: Die Zeit im Turret-Modus ist begrenzt und wird im HUD angezeigt.

Nester und Zeitstrafen

Nestzerstörung durch UFOs: Zerstört ein UFO ein Nest, erleidest du eine Zeitstrafe, die mit der Anzahl verbleibender Nester und deiner verbleibenden Spielzeit zunimmt.
Nestzerstörung durch Spieler: Du kannst selbst ein Nest zerstören, um eine UFO-Zeitstrafe zu vermeiden. Dies zieht jedoch Punkte ab – je höher dein Punktestand, desto größer der Abzug.
Multiplikator bei zerstörten Nestern: Mit jedem zerstörten Nest steigt der Multiplikator, der auch deine Zeitstrafen beeinflussen kann.

Punkte und Multiplikatoren

Punkte für Paare und UFOs: Jedes gefundene Kartenpaar und jedes zerstörte UFO bringt Punkte, die durch den Multiplikator beeinflusst werden.
Multiplikator-System: Der Spiel-Multiplikator erhöht sich bei erfolgreichen Paaren und UFO-Zerstörungen. Der Kill-Streak-Multiplikator für UFOs steigt bei schneller Zerstörung und setzt sich zurück, wenn zu viel Zeit vergeht.

UI-Elemente und Benachrichtigungen

Anzeigen: Das HUD zeigt die verbleibende Zeit, den Punktestand, die Zeit im Turret-Modus und den Multiplikator an.
Benachrichtigungen: Wichtige Ereignisse wie Zeitstrafen und Highscores werden als kurze Meldungen angezeigt.

Strategien

Paare und Multiplikator: Finde Paare zügig, um den Multiplikator zu nutzen und Strafen zu vermeiden.
Effektiver Turret-Modus: Aktiviere den Modus bei UFO-Gruppen, um den Multiplikator und die Punkte zu maximieren.
Nester im Auge behalten: Zerstöre UFOs in der Nähe von Nestern, um Zeitstrafen zu vermeiden.
Taktischer Multiplikator-Einsatz: Setze den Multiplikator gezielt ein, besonders bei sicherer Punktegewinnung und hohem Score.

Hinweise für Fortgeschrittene

Präzises Spielen: Hohe Scores führen zu strengeren Strafen. Minimale Fehler bei hohem Punktestand sind entscheidend.
Spezialfähigkeiten: Nutze Power-Ups, um große Zeitboni oder einen längeren Turret-Modus zu erhalten.

notes.title: Bug Fixes Part 1 – Options & Framerate
notes.content:
Pilots, we've been hard at work addressing some critical issues, and today we’re happy to roll out Part 1 of our Options & Framerate Fixes! 🚀

Key Fixes:
Framerate Options: We have refined the framerate settings in the options menu. Now, when setting a framerate limit, the game runs more smoothly, especially on higher-end systems. The default framerate is now set to uncapped, but you can still choose specific framerates (30, 60, 120 FPS) based on your preference.
VSync Adjustments: The VSync toggle now works correctly with uncapped framerate, preventing screen tearing on higher refresh rate monitors.
Additional Tweaks:
Smoother Transitions: You’ll notice more fluid transitions in the game, especially when toggling between different levels and menus.
Improved Performance on Low-End PCs: By default, we now prioritize system-friendly framerate settings for lower-spec PCs, while allowing high-end systems to push performance to the max.
Please continue testing, and let us know how these changes improve your experience. We're pushing hard for a smoother gameplay journey as we head toward our next update!

Thanks for your ongoing support, Pilots! Stay sharp and aim for the stars. 🌠

notes.title: Space Memory – First Balancing Update!
notes.content:
We’re excited to introduce the very first Balancing Update for Space Memory as part of our ongoing development! This update includes several key adjustments to ensure your experience is as fun and challenging as possible from the very start.

Balance Adjustments:
Time Penalties: Time penalties for destroyed nests are now dynamic, based on your remaining game time and the number of active nests. This adds an extra layer of strategy and excitement to each round!
Multiplier System: We've fine-tuned the score multiplier system to reward you more for finding correct card pairs quickly and efficiently. The faster and more accurate you are, the bigger the rewards!
Turret Mode: The turret mode has been optimized for a smoother experience. After finding a card pair, you’ll now temporarily activate the turret mode to take down UFOs even faster!
Additional Updates:
Leaderboards: We’ve set up the leaderboards so that your high scores are properly recorded and synced.
Bug Fixes: We’ve squashed some minor bugs to ensure a smoother overall experience.
This is just the beginning of the journey for Space Memory, and we’re thrilled that you’re here to join us from day one. We look forward to your feedback and can’t wait to see how far you’ll go!

Thanks for playing, and have fun in your first adventure!
